scientific_integrity: All main statements follow from the explicit scroll normalization, conductor transversality, Frobenius-square polynomial descent, Picard classes and Bertini. Exact arithmetic checks verify listed identities and a finite sample only. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Classification only for the fixed nonnormal cubic x^2 w = y^2 z over algebraically closed fields of characteristic two; self-linkage is generic Cartier multiplicity and not necessarily equality of squared ideals; history priority provisional, especially concerning wild inseparable gluing and prior positive-characteristic set-theoretic intersection constructions; no independent validation.
title: Smooth set-theoretic complete intersections on a characteristic-two ruled cubic
